nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable base contract; privileged role used by onlyOwner and onlyPauseOperator.
Pause flag controlling the whenNotPaused / whenPaused modifiers on token operations.
Address allowed (together with owner) to pause, unpause and to reassign the pause operator.
Mapping of account balances mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _burn, batchTransfer and multiTransfer.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, increase/decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Total token supply, decremented by _burn.
Owner-only function that reassigns the owner state variable.
ERC827 function: writes allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to _spender with msg.value and _data.
ERC827 function: transfers tokens then performs an arbitrary external call to _to with msg.value and _data.
ERC827 function: allowance-based transfer followed by an arbitrary external call to _to.
ERC827 function: increases allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to _spender.
ERC827 function: decreases allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to _spender.
ERC20 transfer gated by whenNotPaused; debits msg.sender and credits _to.
ERC20 allowance-based transfer gated by whenNotPaused.
Sets the allowance of _spender for msg.sender; gated by whenNotPaused.
Increases the allowance of _spender for msg.sender.
Decreases the allowance of _spender for msg.sender, clamping at zero.
Public burn entry point that delegates to internal _burn for msg.sender.
Burns tokens from _from after decrementing the caller's allowance.
Internal burn routine updating balances and totalSupply_.
XCoin batch transfer that computes total = _value.mul(_tos.length) and credits each recipient in a loop before debiting msg.sender.
XCoin multi transfer over parallel arrays of recipients and values.
Operator/owner-only function setting paused = true.
Operator/owner-only function setting paused = false.
Operator/owner-only function reassigning the pauseOperator role.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization, balance debits and allowances.
_spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) inside approveAndCall: arbitrary external call with attacker-supplied target and calldata.
_to.call.value(msg.value)(_data) inside transferAndCall: arbitrary external call after a balance mutation.
_to.call.value(msg.value)(_data) inside transferFromAndCall: arbitrary external call after allowance and balance mutations.
_spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) inside increaseApprovalAndCall: arbitrary external call after allowance increase.
_spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) inside decreaseApprovalAndCall: arbitrary external call after allowance decrease.
all = _value.mul(_tos.length) arithmetic in batchTransfer; the total is computed before any per-recipient credit.

_value parameter of approveAndCall, the allowance amount.
_data parameter of approveAndCall, attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to the external call.
_to parameter of transferAndCall, recipient and external call target.
_value parameter of transferAndCall, the transferred amount.
_data parameter of transferAndCall, calldata for the low-level call.
_from parameter of transferFromAndCall, source of the allowance-based transfer.
_to parameter of transferFromAndCall, recipient and external call target.
_value parameter of transferFromAndCall, the transferred amount.
_data parameter of transferFromAndCall, calldata for the low-level call.
_spender parameter of increaseApprovalAndCall, allowance spender and external call target.
_addedValue parameter of increaseApprovalAndCall.
_data parameter of increaseApprovalAndCall, calldata for the low-level call.
_spender parameter of decreaseApprovalAndCall, allowance spender and external call target.
_subtractedValue parameter of decreaseApprovalAndCall.
_data parameter of decreaseApprovalAndCall, calldata for the low-level call.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership; becomes the new privileged owner.
_to parameter of transfer, the credited recipient.
_value parameter of transfer, the transferred amount.
_from parameter of transferFrom, the debited account.
_to parameter of transferFrom, the credited account.
_value parameter of transferFrom, the transferred amount.
_spender parameter of approve.
_value parameter of approve, the granted allowance.
_spender parameter of increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter of increaseApproval.
_spender parameter of decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter of decreaseApproval.
_value parameter of burn, the amount to destroy.
_from parameter of burnFrom, the account whose tokens are burned.
_value parameter of burnFrom, the burned amount.
_who parameter of _burn, the account debited.
_value parameter of _burn, the amount removed from balance and total supply.
_tos array parameter of batchTransfer; its length drives the total amount computation.
_value parameter of batchTransfer, the per-recipient amount.
_tos array parameter of multiTransfer.
_values array parameter of multiTransfer, must match _tos length.
newPauseOperator parameter of transferPauseOperator.
Cached current allowance read at the start of decreaseApproval before clamping or subtracting.
Total amount _value.mul(_tos.length) held during the batchTransfer loop and debited at the end.
Accumulator of all _values entries in multiTransfer, debited from msg.sender after the loop.
Loop index over _tos in batchTransfer.
Loop index over _tos/_values in multiTransfer.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the caller the privileged owner role.
PauseBurnableERC827Token constructor sets pauseOperator = msg.sender, granting the caller operator privileges.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership reads owner for the authorization check and the OwnershipTransferred event.
The newOwner parameter becomes the owner, transferring privileged control to a caller-supplied address.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyPauseOperator requires msg.sender == pauseOperator || msg.sender == owner before transferPauseOperator.
pauseOperator is read in the onlyPauseOperator authorization check.
owner is also read in the onlyPauseOperator authorization check.
newPauseOperator parameter is written into the pauseOperator state variable.
transferPauseOperator reassigns the pauseOperator privileged role.
pause is gated by onlyPauseOperator, which checks msg.sender against pauseOperator/owner.
unpause is gated by onlyPauseOperator, which checks msg.sender against pauseOperator/owner.
pause sets the paused state variable to true.
unpause sets the paused state variable to false.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before transfer executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before transferFrom executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before approve executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before increaseApproval executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before decreaseApproval executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before burn executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before burnFrom executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before batchTransfer executes.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before multiTransfer executes.
_spender parameter is consumed by approveAndCall.
_value parameter is consumed by approveAndCall.
Attacker-controlled _data enters approveAndCall and is forwarded to an external call.
super.approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner, so any caller can self-grant allowances.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
_data is passed as calldata to the low-level call, allowing arbitrary callee execution.
_spender is the target of the low-level call, so the caller chooses the callee.
approveAndCall invokes _spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) and requires success.
The external callee can re-enter approveAndCall (or other ERC827 entry points) before the allowance state settles.
_to parameter is consumed by transferAndCall.
_value parameter is consumed by transferAndCall.
_data parameter enters transferAndCall and drives the external call.
transferAndCall mutates balances via super.transfer before the external call.
_data becomes the calldata of the low-level call to _to.
_to is the attacker-chosen target of the low-level call.
transferAndCall executes _to.call.value(msg.value)(_data) after transferring tokens.
The callee can re-enter transferAndCall or other token methods while the transfer is being finalized.
_from parameter is consumed by transferFromAndCall.
_to parameter is consumed by transferFromAndCall.
_value parameter is consumed by transferFromAndCall.
_data parameter enters transferFromAndCall and drives the external call.
transferFromAndCall mutates balances via super.transferFrom before the external call.
transferFromAndCall decrements the allowed mapping before the external call.
_data becomes the calldata of the low-level call to _to.
_to is the attacker-chosen target of the low-level call.
transferFromAndCall executes _to.call.value(msg.value)(_data) after the allowance transfer.
The callee can re-enter transferFromAndCall before the allowance/balance update is fully settled.
_spender parameter is consumed by increaseApprovalAndCall.
_addedValue parameter is consumed by increaseApprovalAndCall.
_data parameter enters increaseApprovalAndCall and drives the external call.
increaseApprovalAndCall increases the allowed mapping before the external call.
_data becomes the calldata of the low-level call to _spender.
_spender is the attacker-chosen target of the low-level call.
increaseApprovalAndCall executes _spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) after raising the allowance.
The callee can re-enter increaseApprovalAndCall and observe a partially updated allowance.
_spender parameter is consumed by decreaseApprovalAndCall.
_subtractedValue parameter is consumed by decreaseApprovalAndCall.
_data parameter enters decreaseApprovalAndCall and drives the external call.
decreaseApprovalAndCall lowers the allowed mapping before the external call.
_data becomes the calldata of the low-level call to _spender.
_spender is the attacker-chosen target of the low-level call.
decreaseApprovalAndCall executes _spender.call.value(msg.value)(_data) after lowering the allowance.
The callee can re-enter decreaseApprovalAndCall while allowance state is changing.
_to parameter is consumed by transfer.
_value parameter is consumed by transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits the Transfer event with msg.sender as source.
transfer writes balances for both msg.sender and _to.
_from parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
_to parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
_value parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender], tying spending rights to the caller.
transferFrom writes balances for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
_spender parameter is consumed by approve.
_value parameter is consumed by approve.
approve grants allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
_spender parameter is consumed by increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter is consumed by increaseApproval.
increaseApproval increases the allowance held by msg.sender.
increaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
_spender parameter is consumed by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter is consumed by decreaseApproval.
decreaseApproval lowers the allowance held by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
The oldValue local is the cached allowance used to clamp or subtract in decreaseApproval.
_value parameter is consumed by burn.
burn passes msg.sender as the account whose tokens are destroyed.
burn delegates to the internal _burn routine.
msg.sender flows into _burn as the _who argument when called from burn.
_from parameter is consumed by burnFrom.
_value parameter is consumed by burnFrom.
burnFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender], binding the burn to the caller's allowance.
burnFrom decrements the allowed mapping before burning.
burnFrom delegates the actual destruction to _burn.
_who parameter is consumed by _burn.
_value parameter is consumed by _burn.
_burn decrements the balances entry of _who.
_burn subtracts _value from totalSupply_ through SafeMath.sub.
_tos array parameter is consumed by batchTransfer.
_value parameter is consumed by batchTransfer.
batchTransfer credits recipients from and debits balances[msg.sender].
batchTransfer writes the balances mapping for each recipient and for msg.sender.
_value is the left operand of the _value.mul(_tos.length) total computation.
_tos.length is the right operand of the total amount computation.
The arithmetic result 'all' is used as the amount checked against balances[msg.sender] before the credits.
The local all holds the batch total that is subtracted from msg.sender after the loop, separating the balance update from the credit loop.
The local all accumulates every _values entry in multiTransfer before the single debit.
Loop index i controls iteration over the recipient array in batchTransfer.
_tos array parameter is consumed by multiTransfer.
_values array parameter is consumed by multiTransfer.
multiTransfer credits recipients from and debits balances[msg.sender].
multiTransfer writes the balances mapping for each recipient and for msg.sender.
Loop index i controls iteration over the parallel arrays in multiTransfer.
